text: The Acting General Manager, Economic Development and Culture will provide an update on partnerships with other cities and countries and on engagement with technology sectors. On October 13, 2020, during consideration of Item FA4.1, the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Director, Arts and Culture, Economic Development and Culture to provide more details about the City's partnership with Marseille, as well as information about partnerships between Toronto and other Canadian cities.
The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee received the Item for information.
